title: A guard refuses git commit --amend unless HEAD is a commit this session made
why: [11:51 CST Nov 16, triage] Coordinator relay 11:40 CST, from the lane of #3536 (its words, not verified by triage; coordinator did not verify): the lane's amend rewrote an unrelated commit; its work is archived at origin archive/saved-comment-owner-cut. Searched before filing: steps (no step names an amend guard for another agent's commit; amend-guard-merge-head is a different guard), open PRs and branches. Found: PR #3589 (branch amend-foreign-head, rule amend-foreign-head, red tests only) was closed unmerged at 10:08 CST Nov 16 (REST); its body says the rule is not built there and the incident form is left for the owner to rule. The reason for the close is not read. Reuse that branch and rule name rather than start a second.
source: coordinator relay 11:40 CST Nov 16 of the #3536 lane; filed by triage 8
note: Parked, not built (11:56 CST Nov 16, triage). Coordinator relay 11:52 CST (its read of PR #3589's closing comment, 10:08 CST; triage did not read the comment): the guard refused normal amends of a session's own commits, missed the incident it was built for (the reflog holds no agent id), and the incident lost nothing (push refused as non-fast-forward). Rule building-guard-needs-incident. Reopen on a real loss; the #3536 lane's amend (archived at archive/saved-comment-owner-cut) is a second sighting that lost nothing. Branch amend-foreign-head stays on origin.
